// diagnostic

L1101

A bound `Task` still owes `join`.

What

A bound `Task` still owes `join`.

Why

The program may end before that task finishes; a task's duty is discharged by joining it or using its result.

Fix

Join it with `.join()`, use its result, or write `.detach()` to let it go free.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L1101: tests/ui/browser_bidi/native_bidi_session_handles_cannot_cross_tasks_or_channels.stderr.

Error [jet.ValueNotSendable]: `session` can't cross into a task because `browser.Browser` isn't sendable
  --> tests/ui/browser_bidi/native_bidi_session_handles_cannot_cross_tasks_or_channels.jet:11:26
    |
 11 |     handle: task session.close()
    |                          ^^^^^
 Why: `Browser` owns thread-local state and must stay on the thread that created it; tasks and channels move owned values between threads
 Fix: Give the task plain owned data, or rebuild the value as an owned copy before spawning
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1102

Error [jet.ValueNotSendable]: `session` can't be sent because `browser.Browser` isn't sendable
  --> tests/ui/browser_bidi/native_bidi_session_handles_cannot_cross_tasks_or_channels.jet:13:17
    |
 13 |     sender.send(session)
    |                 ^^^^^^^
 Why: `Browser` owns thread-local state and must stay on the thread that created it; tasks and channels move owned values between threads
 Fix: Send plain owned data instead, or rebuild the value as an owned copy before calling `.send()`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1102
